scripts.install:backend: py -m venv backend\.venv && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:ui
scripts.install:ui: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install pytest-playwright && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m playwright install chromium
scripts.seed:backend: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt && set PYTHONPATH=backend&& backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\scripts\seed_test_data.py
scripts.test:backend:api: set PYTHONPATH=backend&& backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend\app\tests\test_products_api.py backend\app\tests\test_dishes_api.py
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ui
